【文章原文节选】: A modern web app in c | Corey Prophitt # Corey Prophitt » A modern web app in c ## INTRO If you wanted a dynamic website in 1994, you wrote a C program, dropped it in a cgi-bin directory, and let Apache fork it per request. Thirty-two years later, I shipped a commercial web product using fundamentally the same technology. Everything about marketyour.games is modern. It's a web product with user accounts, a search dashboard for content creators, folders for organizing them, payments via Stripe and transactional emails via Postmark. It follows progressive enhancement and doesn't require any JavaScript. Everything is modern except the way it was made and how it is served. Here are my thoughts on writing a real product in C and serving it via CGI in 2026. ## TLDR CGI's decline was justified in 2004 but doesn't hold up in 2026. You can write a modern web application in C. I shipped one. One binary, a SQLite file, three dependencies and the entire thing fits in your head. ## HOW IT WAS DONE The stack is BCHS : OpenBSD, C, httpd, and SQLite. There's no framework. Date Mon 12 October 2026 By Huahai Tags AI LLM Tools Clojure In his October 11, 2026 article, "'AI' is Not a Tool," Rich Hickey argues that LLMs are automation rather than tools because they cannot be wielded. I agree that outsourcing work can cost us opportunities to learn. But his conclusion does not follow. Even by his definition, an LLM can be something a human wields. And using it well takes skill, just as using other tools does. Picking up a saw does not guarantee a straight cut. Holding a chisel does not make you a sculptor. Tools can amplify poor judgment as readily as good judgment. Their usefulness depends on the operator's ability to direct them, interpret feedback, recognize mistakes, and make corrections. Those requirements also apply to LLMs. One of my colleagues used to say, "AI is a mirror." I find that insightful: it reflects who you are, including the curiosity, judgment, and habits you bring to it. The questions you ask and the standards you apply to its answers matter.
